slots.notes: Object-cover looping muted video filling each credit-card front face in the magnetic 3D vertical carousel (one per card, also blurred on the back face); cycles via modulo so count can be 5+.
Full-screen ambient wave artwork rendered behind the card carousel (z-0, pointer-events none, w-full h-auto max-h-screen); transparent so the #000 backdrop shows through.
Brand mark pinned bottom-right of the screen at fixed 40px height, hover opacity 85->100; transparent background.

mechanic: An always-on magnetic vertical 3D carousel of volumetric credit cards (5 stacked z-layers each) that flow upward on a perspective stage with an eased dwell-at-center step and cursor-driven parallax tilt, over a static fullscreen wave backdrop with corner brand overlays.
techDelivery: single-file CDN Tailwind v4 browser + React 18 UMD + Babel standalone (react,typescript presets), authored as one inline <script type="text/babel"> App component
reskinNotes: Three brand wordmark/chip SVGs (WaveBank header logo, JWT card wordmark, contact chip) are inlined directly in JSX with fill="white" and a white->#999999 gradient, so re-tinting them means editing path markup, not a token. Fonts are wired through Tailwind v4 @theme custom properties (--font-sans/mono/manrope/signature) plus a Google Fonts link, so swapping families needs both updated. All copy (headline, descriptor, Order Card CTA) and the five card-detail records (number/name/CVV) are hardcoded in markup. Card and typography sizing are computed in JS from viewport width/height with hard clamps (card max 336px, 1.5925 ratio), making layout font-metric- and aspect-sensitive.
